name: native-index-memory
goal: Bound source indexing memory while preserving complete revision data and resource admission safeguards

evidence: On hosted macOS verification timed out at 1721 MiB available below the 2048 MiB reserve; local full-revision indexing retains 1.7 GB RSS and bounded 256-read experiment retains 1.0 GB with equal output counts.

The standard unit-index source tests cover metadata and HTTP dependencies with small synchronous trees but never exercise many pending reads, their order, completion or rejection. Extend that matrix through SourceIndexService.index with a delayed SourceTree.
